scope: Passive daemon-owned native executable freshness for subscribed terminal processes; no candidate execution, title rewriting or update orchestration

behaviors.contract: Pinned native build identity distinguishes an update from a same-build new inode and clears on rollback, including verified launch symlink retargeting.
Unverified launch entries, PID/start/device/inode mismatches and exited processes are unknown, not guessed current or outdated.
Missing, non-executable and script replacements are unknown and never executed, even after a native launch alias was established.
Request handling only enqueues or returns cached reports, bounds targets and invalid-request responses, and versions new reports monotonically.
The release service integrates with terminal process selection, independent host/application markers, replacement, rollback, tab switching, runtime children and tmux active panes on an isolated bus.
